item.title: BART facing station closures and more if it doesn't find funding soon, report finds
item.description: BART predicts major service cuts if it doesn't find extra funding. A new report cites what would happen if a half-cent sales tax ballot measure fails to pass in November. From station closures to fare increases, here's what changes could be implemented

item.title: Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show: Here's some things to expect and what they mean
item.description: Bad Bunny will perform at the halftime show Sunday, fresh off his album of the year Grammy win for "Debí Tirar Más Fotos." The performance is expected to be a historic moment for Latino culture.

item.title: 'Tell Me Lies' star Jackson White hints at big Season 3 finale
item.description: At SCAD TVfest - What "Tell Me Lies" star Jackson White can say about the Season 3 finale, and what's to come in the "Scrubs" revival.

item.title: SF schools set to shut down Monday as no deal is reached with teachers' union
item.description: SFUSD Superintendent Maria Su says after another round of negotiations with the teachers' union on Thursday, no deal has been reached. Su wants the union to provide counter proposals to the district's latest offer.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Temps dip down slightly this weekend, but still mild for Super Bowl
item.description: The milder-than-usual pattern will continue this weekend, but expect lower temperatures.

item.title: Suspect pleads guilty to first-degree murder in 2021 shooting of former SJ cop Kevin Nisihta
item.description: Former San Jose police officer Kevin Nishita was killed in 2021 in Oakland while on assignment as a security guard for a news station.

item.title: This year's Super Bowl commercials feature AI, weight-loss drugs and celebrities galore
item.description: As Super Bowl Sunday approaches, the battle off the field for advertisers to win over 120 million-plus viewers will be just as heated as the rivalry between the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Last year's apartment fire in SF's Cow Hollow neighborhood sheds light on hoarding disorder
item.description: Last October, a fast‑moving fire tore through a 12‑unit building in San Francisco's Cow Hollow. Residents say the blaze was preventable, and the city ignored repeated warnings about a tenant. We took a look at the threat posed by hoarding and why some worry that budget cuts may put some in danger.

item.title: These friends will have been to all 60 Super Bowls. This year is possibly their last
item.description: It just wouldn't feel like the big game for them if they weren't all there. And this might be the last time they all do it. That's what three old friends were coming to grips with just before this year's matchup.

item.title: Police investigating homicide after shooting, large fire at San Bruno home
item.description: We're told by police the incident started as a shooting investigation at around 3 p.m., on Keefe Court near Rosewood Drive. The shooting victim was taken to the hospital but later died.
